resolution: The global and local profile theses have different quantifier scope. An epistemic limitation or an endorsement disagreement is not truth variation. Aristotle’s reported all-opinions-true target uses a shared unindexed truth predicate and is not silently translated into modern indexed relativism. The conditional contradiction test additionally requires expressed negation to entail logical negation. Models show local variation survives a stable logical sentence, global variation is consistent without that stability bridge, and epistemic differences do not require either variation thesis. None of these tests refutes intuitionist withholding of excluded middle.
